description: This file defines the AnthropicCacheControlHook class, which is a custom prompt management hook used to inject cache control directives into chat completion messages. It provides methods to process message-level cache controls based on specified injection points, handling different content formats, and integrates with the rest of the litellm framework for managing prompts and caching behavior.
